issue.title: Plugin script: Fix ES_HOME with spaces

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When ES_HOME has spaces we get funky "cannot find main class <part of a
directory>" errors. This makes them stop by escaping directories and using
eval instead of exec.

Closes #12504

issue.title: fresh install ES 1.7.2 bin/plugin fails on El Capitan

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
In trying to confirm if another issue still exists on 1.7.2, I got the following error while trying to install a plugin:

$ ./bin/plugin 
./bin/plugin: line 108: /Library/Internet: is a directory

I resolved the issue for now w/ a symlink /Library/Internet -> /Library/Internet Plug-Ins/ and reset $JAVA_HOME. Guessing this is related to #12610, #12504.
